newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Customs seize smuggled gold, arrest foreigners.
newsitem.headline: Customs seize smuggled gold, arrest foreigners.

text.p: Customs officials at Dhaka airport on Monday arrested a Dutchman and a German and seized gold from them worth nearly $300,000, police said.
They identified the two as Dutchman Manfred Theodoras Maria and Austrian Wolfgang Loidl, who flew to Bangladesh on Monday from Singapore on a Thai Airways International flight.
Police said the seized bars weighed 24 kg (52.8 lb).
"The bars were in their hand baggage," one customs official told reporters. "We had a tip and it paid off," he said.
The two each face up to 10 years in jail if convicted, customs officials said.

On September 21, Dhaka airport customs seized 137 kg (301 lb) of smuggled gold in two unaccompanied cartons in what was the country's biggest haul. Police have arrested two local businessmen in connection with the smuggling.
